title: Why did a bird wreck his leaf pile? 🍂
description:
This little magpie is Kachi. Every dawn, a street sweeper grandpa shares his breakfast with it.
One morning, it wrecked his leaf pile… but it wasn't mischief.

In Korea, the magpie is the bird that brings good news 🐦

#Kindness #Korea #Seoul #Grandpa #Wholesome #shorts
pinned: What small thing do YOU keep from someone you love? 💛 Tell Kachi

cuts.cap: Why did this bird wreck his leaf pile?
An hour earlier, only the bird saw it fall.
His late wife knit it for him.

end.phrase: Kachi brings you love, from Korea
